feedback: Keep the inclusion decision, EuroQol support, publication form, single Study, primary family, purposes, study status, and the required main StudyPart. Make these corrections: (1) Replace ProtocolUse pu3 with a SoftwareUse for EuroQol Valuation Technology (EQ-VT) version 2.1. Use DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY and VALUATION_ADMINISTRATION. Keep registry_id null. Keep pu1 as the lite valuation protocol and pu2 as the quality-control protocol. Add a separate SoftwareUse for the xreg package with DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY and QUANTITATIVE_ANALYSIS. Keep registry_id null. (2) Delete ScoringUse su1. The Singapore value set is a study output. The study did not apply it to participant EQ-5D responses. Keep Product p1, its development assertion, and the selected estimation model. (3) Correct the model representation. The authors tested six Tobit regression specifications, each with and without accounting for heteroskedasticity. Do not represent Tobit modelling as a separate candidate model. Make each candidate label identify its Tobit specification. Keep the heteroskedastic ADD20-I specification as PRIMARY_REPORTED. Record accounting versus not accounting for heteroskedasticity as a studied model condition. (4) Add the principal finding that only mobility × anxiety/depression and pain/discomfort × anxiety/depression were significant interaction terms in the selected ADD20-I model; each coefficient was −0.007 with SE 0.003. Link int2 to this finding, not to the dimension-ranking finding. (5) Correct TaskDesign td1. Each final 20-state block contained state 55555 and one of the five specified second-poorest states. (6) Do not classify the 533 eligible registrants as APPROACHED. Remove that Sample or preserve the count with an UNMAPPED_VALUE gap for sample stage. (7) Split du1 into cTTO valuation responses used for model estimation and questionnaire or demographic responses used to describe participants and current health. Both have CURRENT_STUDY_COLLECTION origin and PARTICIPANT_RESPONSE level. (8) Add StudyFactors for interview mode, ethnicity, and education attainment. Use STRATIFIER and preserve the reported levels. Link the applicable findings to these factors. (9) Change “759,375 ordered pairs” to “759,375 pairs of EQ-5D-5L health states.” The source does not say ordered. Preserve the main StudyPart and keep its links valid.
